name: codex-plugin-cc
description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

issues.title: app-server brokers never self-terminate → orphaned process/RAM leak (34 chains, 272 procs, ~2.2GB)
Test suite leaks broker processes — 158 orphans found
codex-companion.mjs hardcodes workspace-write sandbox for write tasks — git push fails with DNS error, work stuck in local worktree
Delegated tasks / reviews can wedge in "running" forever when Codex drops terminal turn events
session-lifecycle-hook: SessionStart appends env exports without dedup - env file grows unboundedly on resume/compact, breaking Bash on Windows (8191-char limit)
Proposal: sharded map-reduce review for large diffs — k concurrent background tasks + a cross-shard integration pass (working prototype, ~4.3× measured)
SessionEnd cleanup fails when review cwd ≠ session cwd — broker.json looked up by cwd-hash, leaving orphan brokers even on graceful /quit
Broker process not cleaned up on session exit — no idle timeout
